criteria.note: finalizer.test.ts 'keeps retrying a failed entry on every flush without counting past the maximum': three more failing flushes leave {failed, 5}; the next flush writes it.
StorageCard.test.tsx 'describes a failed entry with %i attempts': 5 -> 'failed 5 or more times; retried on every flush', 2 -> 'failed 2 times'.
docs/architecture.md states the cap; listed tests pass locally and in CI.

evidence.notes: Card PR CI was green on its first run. Worker's local full npm test: failed: 4 git-spawning tests timed out at 15 s under parallel worker load; not rerun.. That run shared the machine with seven other workers' suites; the integrated branch then passed the full suite on a quiet machine (above). Test-infrastructure fixes made during the bundle: #34 (tests opening workspaces directly no longer force disk syncs) and #36 (installer test starts a 45 KB stand-in instead of a copied node.exe).

outputs.summary: recordFailure stores attempts = MIN(attempts + 1, MAX_FLUSH_ATTEMPTS); failed entries are still retried by every flush and their count stops at 5. StorageCard shows 'failed 5 or more times; retried on every flush' at the cap; architecture.md states the cap.
